result.rationale: These are the exact statement and proof of Theorem 2.3, which incorrectly describes an order-2 swap of Hodge components as complex conjugation, failing when Hodge components have dimension >1.

Both identify that the construction only pins down complex conjugation when the Hodge component has dimension 1, failing for higher-dimensional components (e.g., dim 101 quintic threefold example), matching the annotated defect exactly.
